summary_en: RIKEN TECHNOS executed a block trade of 560,000 shares at 2,359 yen per share via ToSTNeT-3 on September 29, 2026, totaling approximately 1.32 billion yen. The execution consumed 560,000 shares from the authorized 4.0 million share, 8.8 billion yen buyback program authorized in July 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock via Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On September 28, 2026, RIKEN TECHNOS announced that it would execute a block trade of treasury stock via ToSTNeT-3 on the following day. The company placed an order to purchase up to 560,000 shares at the reference price of 2,359 yen per share, derived from closing prices as of September 28. The transaction would occur during the 8:45 a.m. ToSTNeT-3 trading window on September 29, 2026, with results to be published immediately after the trading session. No changes to share quantity or trading venue would be made.

This execution was part of the broader repurchase program authorized by the board on July 31, 2026, which permits acquisition of up to 4.0 million shares for a maximum outlay of 8.8 billion yen through December 30, 2026. As of the announcement date, the company had already acquired 2,110,400 shares for 5.145897 billion yen under this program. The 560,000-share block trade would bring cumulative acquisitions to 2,670,400 shares and 6.467137 billion yen, representing 66.8 percent consumption of the authorized share quantity and 73.5 percent of the authorized budget.
